fields.name: homeyAddress
fields.label: Homey address
fields.hint: Your Homey Pro's address on your network: its IP address (Homey app: Settings, General, Network) or http://homey-xxxxxx.local.

fields.name: apiKey
fields.label: Homey API key
fields.hint: Make one in the Homey web app (my.homey.app): Settings, API keys, New API key, with the permissions to view and control devices, view zones and view and start flows. It is kept in this scene's settings on the frame, like a password.

fields.name: cards
fields.label: Cards
fields.placeholder:
Ceiling light
Living room/Thermostat
flow:Good night
fields.hint:
One card per line: a device's name as Homey names it (or Zone/Name when two share a name, or its id), then optionally | a name, | icon=... and | type=...
flow:Name is a button that starts that flow; *Zone is every device in that zone.
A line starting with # starts a page (a tab), and // starts a note. Leave it empty to show every device, a page per zone.

```
# Living room
Ceiling light
Living room/Thermostat
TV speaker | Speaker
flow:Movie time
# Kitchen
*Kitchen
# Outside
Garden sensor | Garden | icon=sun
```

Types: toggle, light, climate, cover, media, lock, sensor, button.

fields.name: allDevices
fields.label: Every device when Cards is empty
fields.hint: With no cards listed, show every device, a page per zone.

fields.name: devicesEvery
fields.label: Look for new devices every (seconds)
fields.hint: How often the list of devices, zones and flows is read again (a new device, a renamed one). The values on the cards are read at every render.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.hint: Shown at the top, and the name of the first page when the cards have pages.

fields.name: tabs
fields.label: Page tabs
fields.hint: Shown when the cards have pages (# lines). A swipe in from the left or right edge turns the page too.

fields.name: compact
fields.label: Compact cards
fields.hint: Smaller cards with no sliders or buttons: a tap on a card still switches it. More cards fit.

fields.name: showUpdated
fields.label: Show when it was updated
fields.hint: The time of the last update at the top, and how long ago each sensor changed.

options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color

homeyRemote.name: Homey remote
homeyRemote.description: A touch remote for a Homey Pro on your network: cards for its devices (on and off, dimming, thermostats, blinds, speakers, locks, sensors) and flows, on pages by zone or as you list them.
